name: HTTP Native ( {request} )
purpose: Generic HTTP client built on Insert from URL with cURL options: appends query parameters (URL-encoded), optional raw data (Evaluate when dataQuoted), headers, basic auth (-u user:password) and method, captures response headers, and returns JSON with status, code, headers and body typed as object/array/string. Version 1.0.1 of 2017-08-26.
external: Insert from URL (step 122, cURL options built from $curlOptions; VerifySSLCertificates False)
open_question: secret: step 95 builds '-u user:password' from the request's auth object and step 122 sends it. VerifySSLCertificates is False (step 122 option). Stores $$lastCurlOptions (step 132) which holds the credentials in a global variable. Error 1631 handling only when status code is 0 (steps 126-131). Used by FullContact person/company enrich scripts (746, 754).
